d:
After a LONG time scouring & searching the internet for this I finally found it! This was a doujin that was released physically MANY years ago back in C90 that is one of the few quality Blue Submarine No.6 Doujins ever produced! Thankfully the artist who is known as mommy uploaded a scan to booth & now we can enjoy it here.

With this I do firmly believe we have all the high quality Mutio works on here.

Link to the product page, note it's original format is PDF:
https://mommy.booth.pm/items/5953309

Enjoy!
